name: contentpilot-ai-monorepo
description: ContentPilot AI - AI Social Media Content Calendar for Small Businesses

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start --prefix server" "npm run preview --prefix client"
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue.bold,cyan.bold" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.db:migrate: cd server && npx prisma migrate dev
